newsitem.title: NORWAY: Political worries weigh on Norwegian debt.
newsitem.headline: Political worries weigh on Norwegian debt.

text.p: Norwegian bonds weakened partly as a result of political concerns the day after Prime Minister Gro Harlem Brundtland announced her resignation. The new premier, Thorbjoern Jagland, was not expected to change the political course of the ruling Labour Party, analysts said.
Some economists said they feared the proposed 1997 budget could be watered down in parliament by up to nine billion crowns, possibly causing the economy to overheat.
"I am 10 times more afraid of the budget than of Jagland," said one analyst.
The Norwegian crown strengthened to 101.95 against the European Currency Unit, compared with its 102.07 close on Wednesday.
One analyst said there had been aggressive commercial and speculative buying, as the market expected the currency to continue to appreciate given the country's high cash flow from the oil sector.
